title: Composer PCOMP-116: the third and final round fixed everything it was asked to, but its tests still miss four made-up shapes. Land it and ticket them?
bluf: Tap a to land it with the gap ticketed, as you did for MPS-375 and the change-report footer this morning. The final check of the third round you granted found the deploy check line itself right everywhere: across 1,032 test cases on three awk engines it never accepts a script that today's line refuses, never errors, and the engines always agree. All five holes from round 2 are now closed. It still says NO GO on a strict rule: four deliberately broken copies of the check would wrongly accept a script and no test row notices. Each needs a hand-made line no real script holds: a comment indented by one space or tab, or a line holding only a vertical tab, a form feed or a no-break space. Because this was the final round you granted, it does not land without your tap.

options.label: Land it as it is; ticket the four shapes
options.detail: Tuesday opens the PR, waits for CodeQL, and lands it as a squash pinned to the checked commit ce523783; not deployed. A Composer records seat tickets the residue: the four refusal fixtures with their exact shapes, the one safe-direction case, and gawk and the demo machine as unmeasured. Then your approved DEPLOY.md:255 sentence goes in as its own small change, as already agreed.

options.label: A fourth test-only round
options.detail: One builder adds the four refusal fixtures and one acceptance fixture the check described, then one more final check: one builder session and one gate session; the change stays off main meanwhile.

options.label: Stop: nothing from this branch lands
options.detail: Main keeps today's check line and its tests; this branch's line change and its new test rows stay off main. A records seat tickets everything from the residue.

default_action: If you never answer, nothing lands: a Composer records seat tickets the residue, and the branch waits for your tap.
facts: Gate record: Security Composer Briefs/2026-11-03_B1197_STATUS.md, first line: NO GO ROUND 3 (GRANTED, FINAL) @ ce52378 on main f5f33e1; cells 1032, engines 3, refused-to-accepted 0, disagreements 0, errors 0; round-2 survivors 12 before, 0 after; B1181-1 to -4 and K-1 closed.

Same file, BLUF item 3: four mutant-accepts survivors, B1197-1 (N33, an indented comment, cells Y5-09/10/11) and B1197-2 (N15/N16/N17, a vertical-tab, form-feed or no-break-space line, cells Y6-05/06/08); graded Major by the kit's rule G-3 (any survivor in the mutant-accepts direction). B1197-3 Minor is the safe direction.

Residue: Briefs/2026-11-03_B1197_evidence/residue.md: 'The shipped awk line itself is right on every cell: 0 cells where main's line refuses and the new line accepts'; each shape is 'hand-made', counted absent from the three real scripts.
Precedents today: mps-375-template-scan-round-cap-1103 ruled b 'Land it as it is; ticket the gap'; composer-pcomp23-footer-round-cap-1103 ruled a 'Land it; ticket the open case'.
